title: Post-purchase feedback request
description: Ask customers how they liked a recent purchase with quick reply buttons. Feedback request WhatsApp template for ecommerce.
notes: Quick replies lift response rates versus asking for a link click. Send 3 to 5 days after delivery so the product has been used.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, how are you liking your *{{product_name}}*? Your feedback helps us improve and takes just one tap.
